name: My Woods
source:
A girl enters nature to wonder about her problems, and meets with another girl. This girl is strage... Odd. Why is she here?

[From [url=https://toko066.itch.io/my-woods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名少女走进大自然中思索自己的烦恼，却在林间偶遇了另一名少女。那个女孩透着一股古怪……奇异的气息。她为什么会出现在这里？

[摘自[url=https://toko066.itch.io/my-woods]itch.io[/url]]
